svg.title: Bacterium
svg.desc: Rod-shaped bacillus with layered envelope, cytoplasm, nucleoid, ribosomes, pili, and flagellum. Biological basis: Bacteria lack a membrane-bound nucleus; chromosomal DNA occupies a nucleoid, ribosomes fill the cytoplasm, and surface appendages mediate adhesion or motility.
